function: Over-the-air aggregation of FL models with digital 64-QAM: an MLP at the PS predicts local model updates, then closed-form/iterative transmit-receive beamforming minimizes the transmission error (pp. 6-8).
system: Uplink MIMO MAC: K=20 devices with Nt=2 antennas, PS with Nr=2 (4 tested), 64 subcarriers of 15 kHz, 64-QAM, Rayleigh/Rician, no RIS (pp. 3, 8, 11, 12).
method: MLP (one hidden layer, D=160/320) predicting last-layer FL updates, trained online by gradient descent alongside federated training of CNN/ResNet-18; beamformers from closed-form decision-region design plus augmented Lagrangian (pp. 6-8).
data_channel: Fashion-MNIST and CIFAR-10 FL tasks (IID, non-IID); simulated i.i.d. Rayleigh fading (pathloss exponent 2) and Rician (K=7, 10); no 3GPP or measured channel (pp. 8, 11).
test_conditions: Training happens online inside each FL run; conditions varied per run: SNR, Rayleigh versus Rician, K and Nr, IID or non-IID labels (3/6/9 of 10) (pp. 9-13).
baselines: Analog FL [27] and BPSK FL [36] AirComp designs, ChannelComp [41], proposed method without MLP (fixed beamforming), noiseless 64-QAM upper bound (p. 8).
metrics: Test accuracy, rounds to converge, latency per round and in total, MLP prediction MSE, CDF of aggregation error (pp. 9-12).
complexity: MLP complexity O(2V'D), with MLP 22% (Fashion-MNIST) and 3% (CIFAR-10) of model size; beamforming optimization O(L_O K^2); modeled latency 1.26 s per round (pp. 7-10).
openness: none; public datasets Fashion-MNIST and CIFAR-10 only, simulated channel, no code link (p. 8).
q1_support: p. 8: "Rayleigh fading and a pathloss exponent of" - custom i.i.d. Rayleigh channel, Rician variants on p. 11; no 3GPP, COST 2100, DeepMIMO or measured data.
q2_support: p. 11: "of the proposed framework over four channel conditions:" - each condition is its own FL run, the MLP is trained online inside it (p. 6: "The MLP is trained through an online gradient descent"); no model trained in one condition is tested in another.
q3_support: p. 8: "The BPSK AirComp FL framework, from [36], enables" (also analog FL [27]) and "However, ChannelComp from [41] is employed to optimize the" (non-learned optimization); p. 9: "test accuracy by up to 15.5% and 24.5% compared to analog" FL and BPSK FL.
q4_support: p. 8: "Lagrangian method converges, the complexity is" O(L_O K^2) for the beamforming solver; p. 7 gives O(2V'D) for the MLP and p. 8 the MLP at 22% and 3% of the model sizes.
q5_support: p. 8: "The Fashion-MNIST dataset [59] and CIFAR-10" are learning-task datasets only, the channel is simulated, and no code or data link is given anywhere in the paper.
notes: Area 7: AirComp aggregation with digital modulation, beamformers designed from MLP-predicted local updates; the FL model is the learned element, so no_learning does not apply. q3 relies on analog FL [27] and BPSK FL [36] as earlier aggregation designs and on ChannelComp [41] or the no-MLP fixed beamforming as non-learned references; the reviewer may confirm. Latency in Tables III-IV comes from the models of Appendix B, not from hardware measurements.
